name: VIHALS Bed storage box drawer 2 (670×550), white (200 cm set)
description: Second drawer compartment from VIHALS bed storage box set of 2 for 200 cm beds (IKEA: Width of drawer 2 inside = 67 cm). The set's drawer 1 compartment is 570×550×140 mm. Set-level outer omitted because it spans both drawers.

measurements.notes: Official IKEA GB article 305.951.17 (200 cm set): drawer 2 inside 670×550×140 mm. Same page: drawer 1 = 570×550×140. Different article from 806.024.60.
